fields.name: BASICBILLING
fields.fieldText:
BASIC BILLING The Billing section of the RingCentral Online account allows Administrators to view and manage payment and services tied to their RingCentral account. The links below covers the overview of the customer's Service Plan, Additional Services Payment Information, International Calling and more. Account Cancellation and modifications such as changing the Billing Cycle, Upgrade or Downgrade and Removal of Additional services can only be done by transferring the call to the appropriate LOB. IMPORTANT: Only the Super Admin, the Billing Admin or Users with Billing Admin access can perform changes on the Billing Section of the RingCentral online portal. Typical Basic Billing Inquiries
  • Billing Overview
    • All information regarding Basic Billing Overview "Service Plan" and Payment Method" can be seen on this success site Article number 3987 link Billing Overview | RingCentral
      • View Service Plan
      • Usage Info
      • Additional Services
      • Change Billing Cycle
      • Billing History
      • Auto-Purchase
      • Cancel Service Plan (Only for Customer Education)
      • Payment Method
  • International Calling
    • Information regarding setting up is on this link Article number 3431 International Calling - Enable International Calling | RingCentral
    • Follow this link if the concern is regarding International Calling Rates Article number 6164 International Calling - International Calling Rates | RingCentral
  • Meetings
    • RingCentral Meetings is a Cloud Video Conferencing service that unifies HD video conferencing, mobility and web meetings together as a free cloud service. RingCentral Meetings gives the customer the power to video conference and web share, as part of the customer's complete business communications solution. Follow the link for more information regarding RingCentral Meetings Arcticle Number 5760 RingCentral Meetings - Links
  • RingCentral Online Device Order Management Tool
    • The RingCentral Online Device Orders tool is a new tool for Administrators to change a pending order of phone devices and shipping addresses from a customer’s online account. An authorized agent can extend the deadline up to nine (9) hours from Admin Web. Follow this the link for more information on RingCentral Online Device Order Management Tool Article Number 8853 Billing - Online Device Order Management Tool | RingCentral
  • Cost Center Management
    • RingCentral's Cost Center Management enables account Administrators to assign purchases of RingCentral services to a Department or an individual based on Cost Center Codes, which will help companies manage and monitor the expenses for cost control and budget planning. RingCentral's Cost Center Management allows Administrators to create a hierarchical structure of billing codes that reflect their organization by department and/or location as well as RingCentral account, and allocate incurred expenses across that structure as a way to better understand and assign cost. Follow the link below Article Number 8211 Cost Center Management - Overview | RingCentral

fields.name: CCAF1
fields.fieldText:
REASONS FOR SENDING CCAF
  • New account activation from an IN address outside of the U.S.
  • Enabling international calling
  • Activating more than two account on one credit card
  • Activating higher-end auto-purchase amounts
  • Raising the transaction or amount limit per month
  • Activating fax broadcasting
  • Account verification
  • Ownership dispute
REQUEST THE CUSTOMER TO SEND CCAF in order to RESET THE PASSWORD HOW TO SEND CCAF TO RINGCENTRAL:
  • CCAF must be sent via FAX only (800) 520-1568 or (650) 641-2698.
  • Cannot be sent via email
  • Faxes coming in with blocked caller IDs will NOT be processed
  • Review of CCAF can take up to 48 hours to process.
  • For CCAF follow-up and further instructions, contact (877) 510-5787. Business hours: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST.
Please click the link or Go to success.ringcentral.com and find Article Number : 1208 CCAF US For RC UK customers, please go to Article Number: 1886 CCAF UK Recommended Dispositions:
  • Create a case and dispose using Internal Work Flow
  • Fraud
  • Verification Required
NOTE: Leave the case open and wait for the Fraud Team to verify the account once they received the customer's CCAF within 48 hours. Click NEXT to add notes to an existing case or to create a new case for this issue

fields.name: CUSTOMEREDUCATION
fields.fieldText:
CUSTOMER EDUCATION Inform the customer that the payment transaction could be on hold due to bank permission. REMINDERS:
  • Advise the customer to coordinate with their bank
  • Set customer's expectations about the turnaround time of 24 to 48 hrs., and schedule a call back within the time frame
  • Ask questions if the customer has other unresolved issues to ensure complete resolution
  • Leave the case open for monitoring, and follow our CNR process
NOTE: Always consult your Team Lead for further assistance. Click NEXT to add notes to an existing case or to create a new case for this issue

fields.name: CUSTOMEREDUCATION1
fields.fieldText:
CUSTOMER EDUCATION Inform the customer that charges on their Credit Card is restricted by their bank. Refer to the link for billing errors: Common Billing Errors REMINDERS:
  • Advise the customer to call to their bank to clear out the restriction
  • Set customer's expectations about the turnaround time of 24 to 48 hrs., and schedule a call back within the time frame
  • Use probing questions to determine if the customer has any other unresolved issues
  • Take ownership and appropriate action to ensure unresolved issues are handled correctly
  • Leave the case open for monitoring, ensure follow CNR process.
NOTE: Always consult your Team Lead for further assistance. Click NEXT to add notes to an existing case or to create a new case for this issue

fields.name: FAXPRICEALIGNMENTPROCESS
fields.fieldText:
FAX PRICE ALIGNMENT PROCESS How to Identify
  • You can identify if a customer is part of the Fax Price alignment by the SFDC flag listed below under “CM Reporting”.
  • The flag is named by: “PriceAlign-(old price)-to-(new price)- notify(Notification date)- align(Alignment date)”
Example: “PriceAlign-$6.89-to-$9.99-notifyJan27-alignFeb28”
  • Issue Handling If no one’s available to take your call, email faxpricingquestions@ringcentral.com and advise the customer that someone will contact him/her If the customer is calling about account cancellation that is not brought about by price alignment, Retention Pro/Fax team should handle the call. Special projects team business hours is from 7am – 5pm PST (10pm- 8am MNL) Click NEXT to add notes to an existing case or to create a new case for this issue

fields.name: FEATUREINCLUSION
fields.fieldText:
FEATURE INCLUSION The steps below will show you the ways on checking the features included in the customer's account. Important:
  • TSR 1 scope of support is only to discuss feature's that are included on the current RingCentral Account of the customer that are higher than fax and pro plan.
  • for Fax and Pro Plan customer account change can be made in the online account.
  • for customer's that have a higher plan transfer the call to the approriate LOB if the caller wishes to make changes on their service plan.
To check current feature's included using the Online Account for Fax and Pro Plan.
  • Go to Admin Portal > Billing > Service Plan
Note: Ringcentral Plans higher than Pro Plan does not have the Change Service Plan button a workaround is to copy the Service Plan by going to Admin Portal > Billing > Service Plan and searching the article related to that on our success site Success Site
  • A smaller window will open showing the RingCentral Plans only applicable to Fax and Pro plans.
Note: The Customer can also make changes on this window kindly assist the customer in changing account subscription and provide information regarding the changes.
To check current features included using Admin Portal. (RECOMMENDED STEP)
  • Go to Admin Interface > Under Service Level Copy the number code
  • Copy the code and go to confluence site Link RingCentral Plans and Feature Availability Matrix - UPDATED
Note: The link is requires an okta log in, using the code from the admin interface check the features available on that code. for Plans higher than Pro plan only discuss details about the features included if the customer request for a change in subscription refer them to appropriate LOB.

fields.fieldText:
UPDATING CREDIT CARD INFORMATION To view or change your account's card information, follow the steps below: or click the link for self help option https://success.ringcentral.com/articles/RC_Knowledge_Article/9765 Step 1:
  • Log in to your RingCentral Online Account as an Administrator.
Step 2:
  • Under Admin Portal, click the Billing tab, and then click Payment Method. Your account's Card Information is displayed. To change it, proceed to the next step.
Step 3:
  • Click on Edit Payment Method.
Step 4:
  • Enter the card details and click SAVE

fields.name: UPDATINGCREDITCARDINFORMATION
fields.fieldText:
UPDATING CREDIT CARD INFORMATION NOTE: Updating your Credit Card information via IVR can only be completed if the ZIP code of the new credit card is the same as previous credit card. The system will ask you to log on to the RingCentral Online Account or call Customer Service in case the new credit card has a different ZIP code, so that the billing address can be updated as well. Please follow the steps below or click the link for self help option Billing - Update Credit Card Info Over the Phone | RingCentral Step 1:
  • RingCentral US: 888-898-4591
  • RingCentral Canada: 800-591-6543
Step 2:
  • Pres 2 to select Update Credit Card Information.
Step 3:
  • Press 1 to select Change Credit Card Information.
Step 4: RingCentral's Interactive Voice System will attempt to pull your account information using your phone's Caller ID.
  • If you are using your RingCentral device, mobile app, or desktop app to contact RingCentral, the Interactive Voice System will announce the Account Name, based on your Caller ID. Press 1 to confirm if you are calling about the account name announced, or Press 2 to enter a different RingCentral Account Number, followed by the hash sign (#).
  • If the system is unable to pull an account, you will be asked to enter your RingCentral account number, followed by the hash sign (#).
Step 5:
  • Press 1 to confirm the Account Name or press 2 to key in a different RingCentral Number.
Step 6:
  • Enter your PIN and then press #.
Step 7:
  • Enter the 15 or 16-digit Credit Card Number and then press #.
  • NOTE: The Credit Card Number will be announced, if correct, press 1. Press 2 to enter another Card Number.
Step 8:
  • Enter the Credit Card Expiration Date. Press 1 if correct or press 2 to enter a new number.
  • NOTE: The date format should be YYYYMM.
Step 9:
  • Select the Country of your Credit Card billing address. Press 1 for US, otherwise press 2.
    • If US:
    • Enter the 5-digit ZIP Code. If correct, press 1. To re-enter your zipcode, press 2.
    • If Canada:
    • Say the first 3 characters of the ZIP Code, then when prompted, say the last 3 characters.
